description: Send a real SMS reply inside an existing conversation, from the same sending number, on the same project. This delivers an actual text message to the contact and incurs cost. Text is 1-1600 characters, SMS only (no media). Final delivery state arrives on the existing message.sent / message.delivered / message.failed webhooks.
